words.en: The process of providing or obtaining the food necessary for health and growth.

words.ex: He wears a nylon jacket to stay dry.
words.ex_cn: 他穿一件尼龙夹克来保持干燥。
words.en: Nylon is a strong, elastic synthetic fiber used especially in the manufacture of clothing, ropes, and brushes.

words.ex: The travelers found an oasis with water and trees.
words.ex_cn: 旅行者们发现了一个有水和树木的绿洲。
words.en: An oasis is a small area in a desert where water and plants are found, making it a place of relief and beauty in an otherwise barren landscape.

words.ex: He eats oat for breakfast every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃燕麦当早餐。
words.en: A cereal plant cultivated chiefly in cool climates and widely used for animal feed as well as human consumption.

words.ex: Children must obey their parents.
words.ex_cn: 孩子必须遵守父母的规定。
words.en: To obey means to do what you are told or expected to do according to a rule, law, or someone with authority over you.

words.tr:
adj. 客观的；
n. 目标；目的；
words.ex: He gave an objective opinion about the movie.
words.ex_cn: 他对这部电影给出了一个客观的看法。
words.en: An objective is something that you plan to do or achieve.

words.ex: He felt an obligation to help his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他感到有义务帮助他的朋友。
words.en: An obligation is something that you must do because you have promised, because of a law, etc.

words.tr: n. 观察；观测；注意；监视；(观察后的）意见；
words.ex: The scientist made an observation about the bird's behavior.
words.ex_cn: 科学家对这只鸟的行为进行了观察。
words.en: The act of noticing or watching something carefully in order to gain information.

words.ex: The ocean is very big and deep.
words.ex_cn: 海洋非常大且深。
words.en: The vast body of salt water that covers almost three quarters of the earth's surface.

words.ex: He was born in October.
words.ex_cn: 他出生在十月。
words.en: October is the tenth month of the year in the Gregorian calendar.

words.ex: The trash has a bad odor.
words.ex_cn: 垃圾有一种难闻的气味。
words.en: A distinctive smell, especially an unpleasant one.

words.ex: He works in an office downtown.
words.ex_cn: 他在市中心的一间办公室工作。
words.en: An office is a room or set of rooms where people work, especially in a business or organization.

words.ex: It is the officia of every citizen to obey the law.
words.ex_cn: 遵守法律是每个公民的职责。
words.en: The duties or responsibilities associated with a particular role or position.

words.ex: She put oil on the pan before cooking.
words.ex_cn: 她在锅里倒了油再做饭。
words.en: Oil is a liquid that is used as a fuel and for lubricating the moving parts of machines.

words.ex: The old man walks slowly in the park.
words.ex_cn: 这位老人在公园里慢慢走路。
words.en: Having lived or existed for a long time; no longer young or new.

words.ex: He watches the olympics every four years.
words.ex_cn: 他每四年观看奥运会。
words.en: The Olympics are an international sports festival that originated in ancient Greece and includes summer and winter sports competitions in which thousands of athletes from around the world participate.

words.ex: He omitted the last word in the sentence.
words.ex_cn: 他省略了句子中的最后一个词。
words.en: If you omit something, you do not include it in an activity or piece of work, deliberately or accidentally.

words.ex: He chopped an onion for the soup.
words.ex_cn: 他为汤切了一个洋葱。
words.en: An onion is a round vegetable with a light brown skin. It has many layers and a strong, sharp smell and taste.

words.tr:
adv. 在网上地；在线地；
adj. 联机的；在线的；
words.ex: He works online from home.
words.ex_cn: 他在家网上工作。
words.en: Connected to or available through a computer network, especially the Internet.

words.tr:
adj. 开放的；营业的；
v. 打开；开放；
n. 公开；户外；
words.ex: The park is open to everyone.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园对所有人开放。
words.en: If you open something such as a door, window, or lid, or if it opens, you move it so that it no longer covers a hole or gap.

words.ex: He loves to watch opera on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在周末看歌剧。
words.en: An opera is a dramatic work in one or more acts, set to music for singers and instrumentalists.

words.ex: The operation of the machine is very smooth.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器的运行非常顺畅。
words.en: An operation is a planned activity involving many people performing various tasks.

words.ex: He got an opportunity to work abroad.
words.ex_cn: 他得到了一个去国外工作的机会。
words.en: An opportunity is a situation in which it is possible for you to do something that you want to do.

words.tr:
n. 反面；对立面；
adj. 对面的；
prep. 与…相对；
words.ex: The opposite of black is white.
words.ex_cn: 黑色的反面是白色。
words.en: If one thing is opposite another, it is on the other side of a space from it.

words.tr: n. 乐观；乐观主义；乐观精神；
words.ex: His optimism helps him stay happy even when things are hard.
words.ex_cn: 他的乐观让他即使在困难时也能保持快乐。
words.en: Optimism is a feeling of hopefulness and confidence about the future or the success of something.

words.ex: He plays violin in a local orchestra.
words.ex_cn: 他在一个本地管弦乐队中拉小提琴。
words.en: An orchestra is a large group of musicians who play a variety of different instruments together. Orchestras usually play classical music.

words.tr:
n. 顺序；条理；命令；订单；(生物学的)目；
v. 订购；命令；点餐；整理；
words.ex: The books are in alphabetical order.
words.ex_cn: 这些书是按字母顺序排列的。
words.en: If you order someone to do something, you tell them to do it in a way that they have to obey. Order can also refer to the way things are arranged or a request to make or supply something.

words.tr: adj. 普通的；平常的；一般的；
words.ex: He wore an ordinary shirt to school.
words.ex_cn: 他穿了一件普通的衬衫去学校。
words.en: Something that is ordinary is not special or different in any way.

words.ex: She buys organic vegetables at the market.
words.ex_cn: 她在市场上买有机蔬菜。
words.en: Relating to or derived from living matter; denoting or characterized by a harmonious relationship between the elements of a whole.

words.tr: n. 生物体；有机体；有机组织；
words.ex: A bacterium is a simple organism.
words.ex_cn: 细菌是一种简单的生物体。
words.en: An organism is a living thing that has an organized structure, can react to stimuli, reproduce, grow, adapt, and maintain homeostasis.

words.tr: n. 入学介绍；岗前训练；方向；取向；
words.ex: The school held an orientation for new students on Monday.
words.ex_cn: 学校在周一为新生举行了入学介绍。
words.en: The act of orienting or the state of being oriented; the determination of the relative position of something or someone (especially oneself).

words.tr:
adj. 原来的；有创造性的；原版的；新颖的；
n. 原件；原稿；
words.ex: This is the original book I bought last year.
words.ex_cn: 这是我去年买的那本原版书。
words.en: An original piece of writing or music was written recently and has not been published or performed before.

words.ex: His painting shows great originality.
words.ex_cn: 他的画作展现了极大的独创性。
words.en: The quality of being new and original in a way that is not derived from something else.

words.ex: The ostrich runs very fast on the grassland.
words.ex_cn: 鸵鸟在草原上跑得很快。
words.en: An ostrich is a large African bird that cannot fly and has long legs and a long neck.

words.ex: The otter swam quickly in the river.
words.ex_cn: 水獭在河里快速游动。
words.en: An otter is a furry aquatic mammal that is known for its playful behavior and ability to swim gracefully.

words.ex: We had an outdoor picnic last Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 上个星期天我们进行了户外野餐。
words.en: relating to or done in the open air; not inside a building

words.ex: She bought a new outfit for the party.
words.ex_cn: 她为派对买了一套新衣服。
words.en: An outfit is a set of clothes worn together, especially for a particular occasion or purpose.

words.tr: n. 出口；发泄途径；经销店；折扣店
words.ex: The river flows out through an outlet.
words.ex_cn: 河水通过一个出口流出。
words.en: An outlet is a hole or pipe through which liquid or air can flow out, or a point in a wall where you can connect electrical equipment to the electricity supply.

words.tr:
n. 轮廓；纲要；
v. 描画轮廓；概述；
words.ex: The artist drew the outline of the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 艺术家画出了山的轮廓。
words.en: An outline is a line that shows or forms the outer edge of something, or a general description or plan showing the essential features of something but not the detail.

words.tr:
prep. 在...外；
n. 外面；外边；外部；
adv. 在外面；
adj. 外面的；外界的；
words.ex: The cat is sitting outside the house.
words.ex_cn: 猫坐在房子外面。
words.en: The outer side or surface of something; not inside a building; external to a particular place or thing.

words.ex: They live on the outskirts of the city.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在城市的郊区。
words.en: The outskirts of a city or town are the parts of it that are farthest away from its center.

words.ex: She put the cake in the oven.
words.ex_cn: 她把蛋糕放进烤箱里。
words.en: An oven is a device for cooking food, using dry heat.

words.tr: adj. 挤满的；过度拥挤的；
words.ex: The bus was overcrowded at rush hour.
words.ex_cn: 高峰时段公交车挤满了人。
words.en: If a place is overcrowded, there are too many people or things in it.

words.ex: The book is overdue at the library.
words.ex_cn: 这本书在图书馆逾期了。
words.en: If you say that a change or an event is overdue, you mean that you think it should have happened before now.

words.tr:
adj. 在头顶上的；
adv. 在空中；
words.ex: The overhead light is too bright.
words.ex_cn: 头顶上的灯太亮了。
words.en: You use overhead to indicate that something is above you or above the place that you are talking about.

words.ex: He overlooked the mistake in the report.
words.ex_cn: 他忽略了报告中的错误。
words.en: If you overlook a fact or problem, you do not notice it, or do not realize how important it is.

words.ex: The project cost overrun the budget.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目的成本超过了预算。
words.en: If an army or a group of people overruns a place, they take control of it by force. If something such as a place or a piece of land is overrun by things or people, it is filled with them and they spread everywhere.

words.ex: He worked overtime to finish the project.
words.ex_cn: 他加班完成了这个项目。
words.en: Overtime refers to the time worked beyond one's regular working hours, often with additional pay.

words.ex: The report gives an overview of the project.
words.ex_cn: 这份报告对项目进行了概述。
words.en: An overview is a general summary or review of a subject.

words.tr:
adj. 自己的；
v. 拥有；
words.ex: This is my own book.
words.ex_cn: 这是我的书。
words.en: If you own something, it belongs to you.

words.ex: Plants release oxygen into the air.
words.ex_cn: 植物向空气中释放氧气。
words.en: A colourless, odourless reactive gas, the chemical element of atomic number 8 and the life-supporting component of the air.

words.ex: He ate a fresh oyster for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚餐吃了一个新鲜的牡蛎。
words.en: An oyster is a large flat shellfish. Some oysters can be eaten and others produce valuable objects called pearls.

words.ex: He changed his pace to match the group.
words.ex_cn: 他调整了步伐以跟上队伍。
words.en: The speed at which someone or something moves, or with which something happens or changes.

words.tr:
v. 包装；收拾行李；
n. 包裹；小包；
words.ex: She packs the gift in colorful paper.
words.ex_cn: 她用彩纸包装礼物。
words.en: A pack is a container of a particular kind, especially one made of strong paper or plastic and containing a number of the same items. As a verb, pack means to put something into a container, especially in a neat and efficient way.

words.tr:
n. 包；包裹；
v. 包装；
words.ex: He bought a package of cookies.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一包饼干。
words.en: A package is a wrapped container or a set of objects wrapped in paper or packed in a box.

words.ex: He bought a packet of sugar.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一小包糖。
words.en: A packet is a small container in which a quantity of something is sold. Packets are either small boxes made of thin cardboard, or bags or envelopes made of paper or plastic.

words.tr:
n. 垫；爪垫；便笺簿
v. 放轻脚步走
words.ex: She put a pad on the chair for comfort.
words.ex_cn: 她在椅子上放了一个垫子以增加舒适感。
words.en: A pad is a flat piece of material that is used to protect something, to make something more comfortable, or to absorb liquid.

words.ex: He picked up the paddle and rowed the boat.
words.ex_cn: 他拿起桨划船。
words.en: A paddle is a short pole with a wide flat part at one end or both ends, used to move a small boat through water.

words.ex: The newspaper has ten pages.
words.ex_cn: 这份报纸有十版。
words.en: A page is one side of a sheet of paper in a book, magazine, newspaper, or other collection of bound sheets.

words.ex: He felt great pain after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故发生后，他感到极大的痛苦。
words.en: Pain is the feeling of great discomfort you have, for example when you have been hurt or when you are ill.

words.ex: The palm tree grows near the beach.
words.ex_cn: 棕榈树长在海滩附近。
words.en: The inner surface of the hand that extends from the wrist to the base of the fingers; also refers to the tropical tree with large divided leaves.

words.tr: n. 专家咨询组；嵌板；仪器板；
words.ex: The government formed a panel to advise on health policy.
words.ex_cn: 政府组建了一个专家咨询组来就卫生政策提供建议。
words.en: A panel is a small group of people who are chosen to do something, for example to discuss something in public or to make a decision.

words.tr:
n. 恐慌；
v. 感到恐慌；
words.ex: A panic spread through the crowd when the fire alarm rang.
words.ex_cn: 当火警响起时，人群陷入了恐慌。
words.en: Panic is a very strong feeling of anxiety or fear, which makes you act without thinking carefully.

words.ex: He wrote his name on the paper.
words.ex_cn: 他在纸上写了名字。
words.en: A material made from cellulose pulp, derived mainly from wood, rags, and certain grasses, processed into flexible sheets or rolls by deposit from an aqueous suspension, and used chiefly for writing, printing, drawing, wrapping, and covering walls.

words.tr:
n. 游行；阅兵；
v. 游行；阅兵；
words.ex: The city held a big parade on Independence Day.
words.ex_cn: 城市在独立日举行了盛大的游行。
words.en: A parade is a procession of people or vehicles moving through a public place in order to celebrate an important day or event.

words.ex: He wrote a short paragraph about his vacation.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一段关于他假期的短文。
words.en: A paragraph is a section of a piece of writing, usually consisting of several sentences dealing with a single subject. The first sentence of a paragraph typically starts on a new line.

words.tr:
adj. 平行的；
n. 类似的事物；
words.ex: The two lines are parallel and never meet.
words.ex_cn: 这两条线是平行的，永远不会相交。
words.en: Something that is parallel to something else is similar to it in many ways, or happens at the same time as it.

words.tr: n. 寄生虫；寄生生物；依赖他人过活者；
words.ex: The parasite lives inside the host's body.
words.ex_cn: 这种寄生虫生活在宿主的体内。
words.en: A parasite is an organism that lives on or in a host organism and gets its food from or at the expense of its host.

words.ex: My parents go to work every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我的父母每天早上去上班。
words.en: Your parents are your mother and father.

words.tr:
n. 公园；园区；
v. 停放；停车；
words.ex: We walk our dog in the park every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我们每天早上在公园遛狗。
words.en: A park is a large area of land with grass and trees, usually in a town, where people go in order to relax and enjoy themselves. To park a vehicle means to leave it somewhere for a period of time.

words.tr: n. （车辆等的）停放；停车场所；停车位； v. “park”的现在分词；
words.ex: There is no parking near the school.
words.ex_cn: 学校附近没有停车的地方。
words.en: Parking refers to the act of stopping a vehicle and leaving it temporarily in a particular place.

words.ex: The car is in the parking lot.
words.ex_cn: 车在停车场里。
words.en: A parking lot is an area of ground where people can leave their cars.

words.ex: The parliament passed a new law about education.
words.ex_cn: 国会通过了一项关于教育的新法律。
words.en: A parliament is a legislative body of government, typically composed of elected representatives, that is responsible for making laws and representing the interests of the people.

words.ex: Each participant must sign the form.
words.ex_cn: 每个参与者都必须签署表格。
words.en: A participant is someone who takes part in an activity or event.

words.ex: His participation in the meeting was very important.
words.ex_cn: 他参与会议非常重要。
words.en: The act of taking part in something.

words.tr:
adj. 特指的；特殊的；挑剔的；
n. 细节；详情；
words.ex: He wants a particular book, not any other.
words.ex_cn: 他想要一本特指的书，不是别的。
words.en: You use particular to emphasize that you are talking about one thing or one kind of thing rather than other similar ones.

words.ex: He is my business partner.
words.ex_cn: 他是我的商业合伙人。
words.en: A partner is someone who you are involved with in a particular activity, especially in business or in a personal relationship.

words.tr: adj. 兼职的；部分时间的
words.ex: He works part-time at a coffee shop.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家咖啡店做兼职。
words.en: If someone is a part-time worker or has a part-time job, they work for only part of each day or week.

words.ex: We had a small party last Saturday.
words.ex_cn: 我们上个星期六举办了一个小型聚会。
words.en: A party is a social gathering of invited guests, typically involving eating, drinking, and entertainment.

words.tr:
v. 通过；传递；路过；(时间)流逝；
n. 通行证；(考试)及格；
words.ex: He passed the exam with a high score.
words.ex_cn: 他以高分通过了考试。
words.en: To move or go past someone or something; to transfer or hand over something to someone.

words.ex: The passenger got off the bus at the next stop.
words.ex_cn: 这位旅客在下一站下了车。
words.en: A passenger is a person who is traveling in a vehicle but is not the driver or one of the people who works on it.

words.ex: He has a passion for painting.
words.ex_cn: 他对绘画充满激情。
words.en: A very strong feeling of love, hate, anger, enthusiasm, etc.

words.ex: He showed his passport at the airport.
words.ex_cn: 他在机场出示了他的护照。
words.en: A passport is an official document that identifies you as a citizen of a particular country and gives you the right to travel to and from that country.

words.ex: He eats pasta for dinner every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上吃意大利面。
words.en: Pasta is a type of food made from a mixture of flour, eggs, and water that is formed into different shapes and then boiled.

words.ex: He got a patent for his new invention.
words.ex_cn: 他为自己的新发明获得了专利。
words.en: A patent is an official right to be the only person or company allowed to make or sell a new product for a certain period of time.

words.ex: The path leads to the village.
words.ex_cn: 这条路通向村庄。
words.en: A path is a way or track designed for walking or traveling along, especially through the countryside.

words.ex: He showed patience while waiting for the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他在等公交车时表现出了耐心。
words.en: The ability to stay calm and not get angry, especially when there is a difficulty or you have to wait a long time.

words.tr:
n. 病人；
adj. 有耐心的；
words.ex: The doctor helped the patient feel better.
words.ex_cn: 医生帮助病人感觉好些了。
words.en: A patient person is able to wait for a long time or deal with a difficult situation without becoming angry or upset.

words.ex: The pattern of the wallpaper is very simple.
words.ex_cn: 墙纸的图案非常简单。
words.en: A pattern is the repeated or regular way in which something happens or is done.

words.tr:
n. 暂停；停顿；
v. 暂停；停顿；
words.ex: There was a short pause before he answered.
words.ex_cn: 他回答之前停顿了一下。
words.en: To pause means to stop what you are doing for a short time before continuing.

words.ex: He made the payment online.
words.ex_cn: 他在线支付了。
words.en: A payment is an amount of money that is paid to someone, or the act of paying this money.

words.tr:
n. 高峰；顶峰；
v. 达到高峰；达到最高值；
words.ex: The mountain peak is covered with snow.
words.ex_cn: 这座山的高峰被雪覆盖。
words.en: The highest point or level of something; the pointed top of a mountain.

words.ex: She wore a white pearl necklace.
words.ex_cn: 她戴着一条白色的珍珠项链。
words.en: A pearl is a hard, rounded object formed within the shell of a pearl oyster or similar mollusk, highly prized as a gemstone.

words.ex: The pedestrian crossed the street at the zebra crossing.
words.ex_cn: 行人在斑马线处过马路。
words.en: A pedestrian is a person who is walking in a city, town, or village, especially along a pavement or in a pedestrian area.

words.tr:
n. 同辈；同等的人；
v. 凝视；
words.ex: He feels comfortable talking to his peers.
words.ex_cn: 他觉得和同辈交谈很自在。
words.en: A peer is someone who is equal to another in abilities, qualifications, age, background, or social status. As a verb, to peer means to look keenly or with difficulty at someone or something.

words.tr:
n. 钉；支柱
v. 钉（木桩等）以固定；限定
words.ex: He hung the hat on a peg.
words.ex_cn: 他把帽子挂在了一个钉子上。
words.en: A peg is a small device, usually made of wood or metal, that is used to fasten things or to hang things on.

words.ex: He writes with a black pen.
words.ex_cn: 他用一支黑色钢笔写字。
words.en: A pen is a tool used for writing or drawing with ink.

words.ex: He uses a pencil to write his name.
words.ex_cn: 他用铅笔写自己的名字。
words.en: A pencil is an instrument that you use for writing or drawing, consisting of a thin stick of wood with a rod of a black or coloured substance through the middle.

words.ex: There are 38 people in the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 教室里有38个人。
words.en: People are men, women, and children. People is often used to refer to a large group of people, especially when their exact number is not known or not important.

words.ex: She added pepper to the soup.
words.ex_cn: 她往汤里加了胡椒粉。
words.en: Pepper is a hot-tasting powder made from the crushed seeds of certain plants, used to flavor food.

words.ex: His performance in the game was excellent.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中的表现非常出色。
words.en: The act of performing a play, concert, or some other form of entertainment.

words.ex: She bought a new perfume for the party.
words.ex_cn: 她为派对买了一瓶新香水。
words.en: A perfume is a pleasant-smelling liquid which people put on their skin to make themselves smell nice.

words.tr:
adj. 周期的；定期的
n. 期刊
words.ex: The plant has a periodical blooming cycle.
words.ex_cn: 这种植物有周期性的开花周期。
words.en: A periodical is a magazine, especially one that is published regularly, or something that happens at regular intervals.

words.tr: adj. 易腐烂的；易坏的；易毁灭的
words.ex: Milk is a perishable food.
words.ex_cn: 牛奶是一种易腐食品。
words.en: Likely to decay or go bad quickly.

words.ex: He made a permanent change to his lifestyle.
words.ex_cn: 他对自己的生活方式做出了永久的改变。
words.en: Something that is permanent exists or happens all the time, or exists for a long time without changing.

words.tr:
n. 许可证；
v. 允许；准许；
words.ex: He showed his fishing permit to the officer.
words.ex_cn: 他向官员出示了他的钓鱼许可证。
words.en: If someone permits something, they allow it to happen. If they permit you to do something, they allow you to do it.

words.ex: This is my personal notebook.
words.ex_cn: 这是我的个人笔记本。
words.en: Relating to or belonging to a particular person rather than to a group or an organization.

words.ex: His personality is very friendly and outgoing.
words.ex_cn: 他的个性非常友好和外向。
words.en: The combination of characteristics or qualities that form an individual's distinctive character.

words.tr: n. 视角；观点；（对事物的）合理判断；
words.ex: His perspective on life is very positive.
words.ex_cn: 他对生活的看法非常积极。
words.en: A particular attitude towards or way of regarding something; a point of view.

words.ex: He tried to persuade her to stay.
words.ex_cn: 他试图说服她留下。
words.en: If you persuade someone to do something, you cause them to do it by giving them good reasons for doing it.

words.ex: He is persuading his friend to join the team.
words.ex_cn: 他正在说服他的朋友加入团队。
words.en: To persuade someone means to cause them to do or believe something, especially by giving them a good reason to do it or by talking to them and making them believe it.

words.ex: His speech was persuasive and made everyone agree.
words.ex_cn: 他的演讲很有说服力，让所有人都同意了。
words.en: A persuasive argument or reason is one that makes you believe that something is true or right.

words.ex: The farmer tried to kill the pest with a spray.
words.ex_cn: 农民试图用喷雾杀死害虫。
words.en: A pest is an animal or insect that damages crops, food, or livestock, or is generally troublesome. It can also refer to a person or thing that causes annoyance or trouble.

words.ex: Farmers use pesticide to kill insects on crops.
words.ex_cn: 农民使用杀虫剂来杀死作物上的昆虫。
words.en: A pesticide is a chemical substance used to kill pests, especially insects, that damage crops or are harmful to human health.

words.ex: My dog is my favorite pet.
words.ex_cn: 我的狗是我最喜欢的宠物。
words.en: A pet is an animal that you keep in your home to give you company and pleasure.

words.ex: He buys petrol every Friday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周五买汽油。
words.en: A liquid obtained from petroleum, used especially as a fuel in cars.

words.ex: The rainbow is a natural phenomenon.
words.ex_cn: 彩虹是一种自然现象。
words.en: A phenomenon is something that is observed to happen or exist, especially something that is unusual or interesting.

words.ex: He likes to study philosophy in his free time.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在空闲时间学习哲学。
words.en: Philosophy is the study or creation of theories about basic things such as the nature of existence, knowledge, and thought, or about how people should live.

words.tr:
n. 电话；
v. 打电话；
words.ex: I lost my phone yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 我昨天丢了电话。
words.en: A phone is a piece of equipment that you use to talk to someone who is in another place.

words.ex: The photocopier broke down this morning.
words.ex_cn: 这台复印机今天早上坏了。
words.en: A photocopier is a machine that makes copies of documents or pictures by photographing them.

words.ex: He left the photocopies on the desk.
words.ex_cn: 他把复印件留在了桌子上。
words.en: Photocopies are copies of documents or images made by a photocopier.

words.ex: I need a photocopy of my passport.
words.ex_cn: 我需要一份护照的影印本。
words.en: A photocopy is a copy of a document made by a photocopier.

words.tr:
n. 照片；相片；
v. 拍照；
words.ex: He showed me a photograph of his dog.
words.ex_cn: 他给我看了他狗的照片。
words.en: A photograph is a picture that is made using a camera.

words.ex: I put the photos on the table.
words.ex_cn: 我把照片放在桌子上。
words.en: Photos are images taken by a camera and recorded on a photosensitive surface or digitally.

words.ex: He learned a new phrase in Spanish.
words.ex_cn: 他学了一个新的西班牙语短语。
words.en: A phrase is a short group of words that people often use as a way of saying something. The meaning of a phrase is often not obvious from the meaning of the individual words in it.

words.tr: adj. 身体的；物质的；物理的；外观的；
words.ex: He has a physical injury from the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在这次事故中受了身体上的伤。
words.en: Relating to the body as opposed to the mind; relating to things that can be seen or touched, as opposed to things that are abstract or imaginary.

words.ex: He likes to study physics in school.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在学校学习物理。
words.en: Physics is the scientific study of matter, energy, force, and motion, and how they relate to each other.

words.tr: n. 钢琴家；钢琴弹奏者；
words.ex: The pianist played a beautiful song at the concert.
words.ex_cn: 这位钢琴家在音乐会上演奏了一首美妙的曲子。
words.en: A pianist is a person who plays the piano, especially professionally.

words.ex: He plays the piano every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上弹钢琴。
words.en: A piano is a large musical instrument with a keyboard. When you press the keys, small hammers hit strings inside the piano, which produce musical notes.

words.tr:
n. 野餐；
v. 去野餐；
words.ex: We had a picnic in the park on Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 我们在周日去公园野餐了。
words.en: A picnic is a meal eaten outdoors, especially in the countryside, usually as part of a trip or outing.

words.tr:
n. 件；作品；片；块；
v. 拼凑；
words.ex: She bought a piece of cake.
words.ex_cn: 她买了一块蛋糕。
words.en: A piece of something is an amount of it that has been broken off, torn off, or cut off.

words.ex: The pigeon sits on the window sill.
words.ex_cn: 鸽子坐在窗台上。
words.en: A pigeon is a bird, usually grey in color, that is often seen in towns and is sometimes used for carrying messages.

words.ex: There is a pile of books on the table.
words.ex_cn: 桌子上有一堆书。
words.en: A pile of things is a quantity of them lying on top of one another. If you pile things somewhere, you put them there so that they form a pile.

words.ex: He took a pill for his headache.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了一粒药丸来缓解头痛。
words.en: A pill is a small solid mass of medicine that you swallow whole.

words.ex: He put his head on the pillow and fell asleep.
words.ex_cn: 他把头放在枕头上，睡着了。
words.en: A pillow is a cushion that you rest your head on when you are in bed.

words.ex: The pilot landed the plane safely.
words.ex_cn: 飞行员安全地降落了飞机。
words.en: A pilot is a person who operates the flying controls of an aircraft. Also, to pilot something means to test or introduce a new idea, product, etc., to see if it will be successful.

words.ex: The pine grows tall in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 松树在森林里长得很高。
words.en: A pine is a type of evergreen tree which has long thin leaves called needles and produces cones. As a verb, to pine means to feel a deep longing or desire for something or someone.

words.ex: The company built a pipeline to carry oil.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司建造了一条输送石油的管道。
words.en: A pipeline is a long pipe, often underground, through which a liquid or gas is carried over a long distance.

words.ex: The pirate sailed the sea with a black flag.
words.ex_cn: 海盗带着黑旗在海上航行。
words.en: A pirate is someone who attacks and robs ships at sea. The term can also refer to someone who illegally copies and distributes software, music, or films.

words.tr: n. 比萨饼；披萨；意大利薄饼；
words.ex: I ate a pizza for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 我晚餐吃了一块比萨饼。
words.en: A pizza is a flat, round piece of dough baked with tomato, cheese, and sometimes other ingredients on top.

words.tr:
n. 地方；方位；
v. 安放；安置；
words.ex: This is a quiet place to read books.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个安静的地方读书。
words.en: A particular position or point in space.

words.tr: n. 实习工作；安排；放置；
words.ex: He got a placement at a local company this summer.
words.ex_cn: 他今年夏天获得了一份在本地公司的实习工作。
words.en: The act of placing something or someone in a particular position or the process of finding a suitable place or job for someone.

words.tr:
n. 计划；打算；
v. 计划；打算；
words.ex: He made a plan to visit his grandparents.
words.ex_cn: 他制定了一个去看望祖父母的计划。
words.en: A plan is a detailed proposal for doing or achieving something.

words.ex: The planet Mars is red.
words.ex_cn: 火星是红色的。
words.en: A planet is a large object in space that moves around a star, such as the sun, and does not produce its own light.

words.tr: v. 计划；“plan”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 计划了的；根据计划的；
words.ex: He planned a trip to the beach last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周计划了一次去海滩的旅行。
words.en: Something that is planned is arranged or prepared in advance.

words.tr:
n. 植物；工厂；发电厂；装置；
v. 种植；栽培；
words.ex: The plant grows near the window.
words.ex_cn: 这株植物长在窗边。
words.en: A plant is a living thing that grows in the earth and has a stem, leaves, and roots. As a verb, to plant means to put a seed or plant into the ground so that it will grow.

words.tr:
n. 塑料；
adj. 塑料的；
words.ex: The bottle is made of plastic.
words.ex_cn: 这个瓶子是塑料做的。
words.en: A plastic is a material which is produced from oil by a chemical process and which is used to make many objects. It is light in weight and does not break easily.

words.ex: She put the food on a clean plate.
words.ex_cn: 她把食物放在一个干净的盘子里。
words.en: A flat dish, typically circular and made of china, from which food is eaten or served.

words.ex: The teacher stood on the platform to speak.
words.ex_cn: 老师站在平台上讲话。
words.en: A platform is a flat, raised structure, usually made of wood, which people stand on when they make speeches or give performances.

words.ex: We watched three plays last week.
words.ex_cn: 我们上周看了三部戏剧。
words.en: To engage in activity for enjoyment and recreation rather than a serious or practical purpose.

words.tr: n. 运动员；选手；唱机；玩家；
words.ex: The player scored a goal in the final minute.
words.ex_cn: 这名运动员在最后一分钟进了一球。
words.en: A player is someone who takes part in a game or sport, or someone who performs in a theatrical production or musical performance.

words.ex: He is a famous playwright who writes plays.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位著名的剧作家，写剧本。
words.en: A playwright is a person who writes plays.

words.ex: The farmer ploughs the field every spring.
words.ex_cn: 农民每年春天都犁地。
words.en: A plough is a large farming implement with one or more blades fixed in a frame, drawn over soil to turn it over and cut furrows in preparation for the planting of seeds. It can also mean to move forward with difficulty or to work hard at something.

words.tr:
n. 梅子；李子；紫红色；青紫色；令人垂涎的东西
adj. 令人垂涎的；吸引人的
words.ex: He ate a ripe plum for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐吃了一个熟透的李子。
words.en: A plum is a sweet, juicy fruit with a smooth, red or purple skin and a stone in the middle.

words.tr:
n. 毒药；毒物；
v. 毒害；
words.ex: The snake's poison can kill quickly.
words.ex_cn: 蛇的毒药能迅速致死。
words.en: A poison is a substance that causes harm or death if it is swallowed, absorbed, or breathed in. It can also refer to something that has a very harmful effect on something else.

words.ex: The frog is poisonous.
words.ex_cn: 这只青蛙是有毒的。
words.en: Something that is poisonous will kill you or make you ill if you eat it, drink it, or absorb it.

words.tr:
n. 警方；警察部门；
v. 监督；
words.ex: The police caught the thief last night.
words.ex_cn: 警方昨晚抓到了小偷。
words.en: The police are the official organization that is responsible for making sure that people obey the law, for catching criminals, and for keeping public order.

words.ex: The government changed its education policy.
words.ex_cn: 政府改变了它的教育政策。
words.en: A policy is a set of ideas or plans that is used as a basis for making decisions, especially in politics, economics, or business.

words.tr:
n. 光泽；上光剂；
v. 擦亮；润色；
words.ex: The polish of the wooden table made it shine.
words.ex_cn: 木桌的光泽让它闪闪发亮。
words.en: If you polish something, you make it smooth and shiny by rubbing it with a cloth or a special substance. Polish is also a substance that you use to make things smooth and shiny.

words.ex: He is polite to everyone he meets.
words.ex_cn: 他对遇到的每个人都很有礼貌。
words.en: Having or showing behavior that is respectful and considerate of other people.

words.ex: He is interested in political news.
words.ex_cn: 他对政治新闻感兴趣。
words.en: Relating to the government or public affairs of a country.

words.ex: He is interested in politics.
words.ex_cn: 他对政治感兴趣。
words.en: Politics are the actions or activities concerned with achieving and using power in a country or society. The verb that follows politics may be either singular or plural.

words.ex: The poll showed that most people support the new law.
words.ex_cn: 这项民意调查表明，大多数人支持这项新法律。
words.en: A poll is a survey in which people are asked their opinions about something, usually in order to find out how popular something is or what people intend to do in the future.

words.ex: The factory releases a pollutant into the river.
words.ex_cn: 工厂向河里排放一种污染物。
words.en: A pollutant is a substance that pollutes something, especially air, water, or soil.

words.ex: The river is dirty because of pollution.
words.ex_cn: 这条河因为污染而变得肮脏。
words.en: Pollution is the process of making air, water, soil, etc. dirty and not safe or suitable to use.

words.ex: Ducks swim in the pond.
words.ex_cn: 鸭子在池塘里游泳。
words.en: A pond is a small area of water that is smaller than a lake, often artificially created.

words.tr: n. 水塘；水池；备用物资；美式撞球；
words.ex: The children play near the small pool.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在小水塘边玩耍。
words.en: A pool is a small area of still water, especially one that is artificially created.

words.tr: adj. 拙劣的；贫穷的；缺少的；可怜的；
words.ex: The acting in that movie was poor.
words.ex_cn: 那部电影的表演很拙劣。
words.en: If you describe someone as poor, you mean that they do not have enough money to live on or that they have very little money.

words.ex: The population of this city is growing fast.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市的人口正在快速增长。
words.en: The number of people living in a particular area, city, or country; the total number of people who live in a place.

words.ex: The ship arrived at the port at noon.
words.ex_cn: 船在中午到达了港口。
words.en: A port is a place where ships load and unload goods or passengers.

words.ex: This portable charger works well on trips.
words.ex_cn: 这个便携式充电器在旅行时很好用。
words.en: Capable of being carried or moved about with ease.

words.ex: He painted a portrait of his mother.
words.ex_cn: 他画了一幅他母亲的肖像。
words.en: A portrait is a painting, drawing, or photograph of a particular person.

words.tr:
n. 邮件；职位；邮寄；帖子；柱；
v. 邮寄；张贴；
words.ex: I checked the post this morning.
words.ex_cn: 我今天早上检查了邮件。
words.en: To post something means to send it through the postal system or to display it publicly, such as on a noticeboard or the internet. It can also refer to the act of assigning someone to a particular job or position.

words.ex: He put the letter in the postbox.
words.ex_cn: 他把信放进邮箱里。
words.en: A postbox is a public box with a slot into which letters are put for collection by the post office.

words.ex: He put up a poster on the wall.
words.ex_cn: 他把一张海报贴在墙上。
words.en: A poster is a large notice or picture that you stick on a wall or board, often in order to advertise something.

words.tr:
n. 研究生；
adj. 大学毕业后的；
words.ex: He is a postgraduate at Beijing University.
words.ex_cn: 他是北京大学的一名研究生。
words.en: A postgraduate is a student who continues studying after obtaining a first degree, usually in order to obtain a higher qualification.

words.ex: They decided to postpone the meeting until next week.
words.ex_cn: 他们决定把会议推迟到下周。
words.en: To postpone something means to arrange for it to take place at a later time than was originally planned.

words.ex: He sat with good posture at the desk.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在书桌前，姿势端正。
words.en: Your posture is the way in which you hold your body when you are standing or sitting.

words.ex: She poured tea from the pot.
words.ex_cn: 她从壶里倒出了茶。
words.en: A pot is a deep round container used for cooking.

words.tr:
n. 潜力；
adj. 潜在的；
words.ex: The young athlete shows great potential.
words.ex_cn: 这位年轻运动员展现出巨大的潜力。
words.en: If you say that someone or something has potential, you mean that they have the necessary abilities or qualities to become successful or useful in the future.

words.tr: n. 陶器；制陶手艺；陶器作坊；
words.ex: He makes pottery in his backyard studio.
words.ex_cn: 他在后院的工作室制作陶器。
words.en: Objects such as pots, dishes, and vases that are made out of clay and then baked at high temperatures to make them hard.

words.ex: Many children suffer from poverty in poor countries.
words.ex_cn: 许多孩子在贫穷国家遭受贫困。
words.en: Poverty is the state of being extremely poor.

words.ex: He spilled powder on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 他把粉末撒在了地上。
words.en: A powder is a dry substance made up of very small particles. It can be used for various purposes, including cosmetics, cleaning, and cooking. As a verb, to powder means to apply or cover something with powder.

words.tr:
n. 力量；电源；权力；强国；
v. 给…提供能量；供以动力；
words.ex: The power of the storm broke the trees.
words.ex_cn: 风暴的力量折断了树木。
words.en: The ability or capacity to do something or act in a particular way; control or influence over others; electrical energy supplied to a device or building.

words.ex: His hard work received much praise from the teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他的努力工作得到了老师的许多赞美。
words.en: If you praise someone or something, you express approval for their achievements or qualities.

words.ex: He gave a precise answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题给出了准确的答案。
words.en: If you give precise information or precise instructions, you give exact details so that there is no confusion about what should be done.

words.tr: n. 掠夺者；捕食性动物；食肉动物；
words.ex: The lion is a predator that hunts deer.
words.ex_cn: 狮子是一种捕食鹿的掠夺者。
words.en: A predator is an animal that naturally preys on others.

words.ex: The weather was predictable today, just like yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 今天的天气和昨天一样，是可以预见的。
words.en: If you say that an event or a situation is predictable, you mean that it is obvious in advance that it will happen or what it will be like.

words.ex: He has a preference for tea over coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他更喜欢茶而不是咖啡。
words.en: A preference is a greater liking for one alternative over another or others.

words.ex: He is the premier player on the team.
words.ex_cn: 他是队里最优秀的球员。
words.en: The premier is the leader of the government in some countries, equivalent to a prime minister.

words.ex: The movie's premiere was held last night.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影的首映昨晚举行。
words.en: The first public performance of a play, film, or other form of entertainment.

words.ex: The doctor wrote a prescription for medicine.
words.ex_cn: 医生开了一张药方。
words.en: A prescription is a written order from a physician for the preparation and administration of a drug or device for a patient.

words.tr:
adj. 目前的；在场的；
n. 目前；礼物；
v. 呈现；提出；
words.ex: The present situation is very difficult.
words.ex_cn: 目前的形势非常困难。
words.en: If you say that someone is present at an event, you mean that they are there.

words.ex: He gave a presentation about climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他做了一个关于气候变化的报告。
words.en: The act of showing or explaining something to an audience.

words.ex: The museum focuses on the preservation of old books.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆专注于旧书的保存。
words.en: The act of keeping something in its original state or in good condition.

words.tr:
v. 保存；保护；保持；
n. （某群体）专有的活动；
words.ex: She preserves fresh fruit by making jam.
words.ex_cn: 她通过做果酱来保存新鲜水果。
words.en: To preserve something means to maintain it in its original or existing state.

words.tr:
n. 新闻界；出版社；
v. 按；压；
words.ex: The press reported the news quickly.
words.ex_cn: 新闻界迅速报道了这则新闻。
words.en: To press something is to push it firmly, often with your fingers or hand, in order to operate a device or machine, or to make something flat or smooth. It can also mean to urge someone to do something or to make a strong demand for something.

words.tr:
n. 压力；压强；
v. 对…施加压力；
words.ex: He feels pressure from his parents to get good grades.
words.ex_cn: 他感受到来自父母要取得好成绩的压力。
words.en: Pressure is the force that you produce when you press hard on something, or the force that is produced by a particular amount of gas or liquid in a confined space.

words.tr: adj. 普遍的；流行的；盛行的；
words.ex: Smoking is prevalent in that country.
words.ex_cn: 在那个国家，吸烟很普遍。
words.en: If a condition, practice, or belief is prevalent, it is common or widespread.

words.ex: Wearing a helmet can prevent head injuries.
words.ex_cn: 戴头盔可以防止头部受伤。
words.en: To prevent something means to stop it from happening or to stop someone from doing something.

words.ex: Handwashing is a simple prevention of disease.
words.ex_cn: 洗手是预防疾病的一种简单方法。
words.en: The act of stopping something from happening or arising.

words.ex: He read the previous chapter last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚读了前一章。
words.en: Existing or occurring before in time or order.

words.tr:
n. 猎物；受害者；受骗者；
v. 捕食；坑害；折磨；
words.ex: The lion chased its prey across the plain.
words.ex_cn: 狮子在平原上追逐它的猎物。
words.en: An animal that is hunted and killed by another for food.

words.ex: The price of bread is too high.
words.ex_cn: 面包的价格太高了。
words.en: The amount of money expected, required, or given in payment for something.

words.tr: adj. 首要的；小学的；初等的；原来的；最初的；
words.ex: Primary goal is to stay safe.
words.ex_cn: 首要目标是保持安全。
words.en: Something that is primary is more important than anything else.

words.ex: The prince rode a white horse through the castle gate.
words.ex_cn: 王子骑着一匹白马穿过城堡的大门。
words.en: A prince is a male member of a royal family, especially the son of a king or queen.

words.tr:
adj. 主要的；最重要的；
n. 校长；负责人；
words.ex: The principal reason for his success is hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他成功的主要原因是努力工作。
words.en: The person with the highest authority or most important position in an organization, institution, or group.

words.ex: The printer is out of paper.
words.ex_cn: 打印机没有纸了。
words.en: A printer is a machine that can be connected to a computer in order to make copies on paper of documents or other information held by the computer.

words.ex: Prior to the meeting, we reviewed the report.
words.ex_cn: 在会议之前，我们复习了报告。
words.en: Existing or coming before in time, order, or importance.

words.tr: n. 需优先考虑的事；优先权；
words.ex: Homework is my top priority.
words.ex_cn: 作业是我最需要优先考虑的事。
words.en: If something is a priority, it is the most important thing you have to do or deal with, or must be done or dealt with before everything else you have to do.

words.ex: He was sent to prison for stealing.
words.ex_cn: 他因偷窃被送进了监狱。
words.en: A prison is a building where criminals are kept as punishment or where people accused of a crime are kept before their trial.

words.ex: He values his privacy and doesn't share personal info online.
words.ex_cn: 他重视自己的隐私，不在网上分享个人信息。
words.en: The state or condition of being free from being observed or disturbed by other people.

words.ex: He keeps his diary private.
words.ex_cn: 他把日记保密。
words.en: If something is private, it is for the use of one person or group, rather than for the general public.

words.tr:
n. 奖赏；奖品；奖金；
v. 珍视；
words.ex: He won a prize for the best science project.
words.ex_cn: 他因最好的科学项目获得了奖赏。
words.en: A prize is something valuable, such as money or a trophy, that is given to someone who wins a competition or who has done outstanding work.

words.ex: This math problem is very hard.
words.ex_cn: 这道数学难题很难。
words.en: A problem is a situation that is unsatisfactory and causes difficulties for people.

words.ex: Follow the procedure step by step.
words.ex_cn: 一步一步地按照步骤进行。
words.en: A procedure is a way of doing something, especially the usual or correct way.

words.ex: After the break, we will proceed with the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 休息后，我们将继续开会。
words.en: If you proceed to do something, you continue to do it or start to do it after doing something else first.

words.tr:
n. 工序；过程；
v. 处理；加工；
words.ex: The factory improved the production process.
words.ex_cn: 工厂改进了生产工序。
words.en: A process is a series of actions which are carried out in order to achieve a particular result.

words.tr: n. 处理；加工； v. 处理；加工；“process”的现在分词；
words.ex: The processing of data takes a long time.
words.ex_cn: 数据的处理需要很长时间。
words.en: The act of treating or preparing something by a special method.

words.tr:
v. 生产；制造；导致；引起；生育；出示；
n. 农产品；
words.ex: The farm produces fresh vegetables every day.
words.ex_cn: 这个农场每天生产新鲜蔬菜。
words.en: To produce something means to make, create, or manufacture it, often in large quantities. It can also refer to the act of causing something to happen or exist.

words.ex: This company makes a new product every year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司每年都会推出一种新产品。
words.en: A product is something that is produced and sold in large quantities, often as a result of a manufacturing process.

words.ex: The factory improved its productivity by using new machines.
words.ex_cn: 工厂通过使用新机器提高了生产率。
words.en: Productivity is the rate at which goods are produced or work is completed.

words.ex: The professor teaches physics at the university.
words.ex_cn: 这位教授在大学教物理。
words.en: A professor is a senior teacher in a college or university.

words.ex: He has great proficiency in English.
words.ex_cn: 他的英语水平很高。
words.en: If you show proficiency in something, you show ability or skill at it.

words.tr: n. 受公众注意的程度；简介；轮廓；
words.ex: The celebrity's profile rose after the TV interview.
words.ex_cn: 这位名人经过电视采访后，受公众注意的程度提高了。
words.en: A profile is a side view of something, especially a person's face, or a brief description of someone or something.

words.tr:
n. 利润；
v. 获利；
words.ex: The company made a big profit this year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司今年赚了大量利润。
words.en: Profit is the amount of money that you gain when you are paid more for something than it cost you to make, get, or do it.

words.tr:
n. 节目；程序；
v. 编程；
words.ex: We watched a funny program on TV last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚在电视上看了一个有趣的节目。
words.en: A program is a set of instructions that a computer follows in order to perform a particular task.

words.tr: n. 进展；进步；缓慢前进；稳步前进；
words.ex: The project shows slow progress.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目进展缓慢。
words.en: Progress is the process of gradually improving or getting nearer to achieving or completing something.

words.ex: The school prohibits students from using phones in class.
words.ex_cn: 学校禁止学生在课堂上使用手机。
words.en: If a law or someone in authority prohibits something, they forbid it or make it illegal.

words.tr:
n. 计划；方案；项目；课题；
v. 投射；预计；
words.ex: He presented his school project to the class.
words.ex_cn: 他向全班展示了他的学校计划。
words.en: A project is a piece of work that is planned or intended, or a large piece of work that is done by a group of people.

words.ex: The projection of the movie started at 8 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 电影的放映晚上8点开始。
words.en: A projection is an estimate or forecast of a future situation or trend based on a study of present ones.

words.ex: The teacher turned on the projector to show the video.
words.ex_cn: 老师打开投影仪来播放视频。
words.en: A projector is a machine that projects films or slides onto a screen or wall.

words.tr: v. 促进；推动；宣传；推销；
words.ex: Exercise can promote good health.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼可以促进健康。
words.en: To promote means to help something to happen, develop, or increase, or to raise someone to a higher position or rank.

words.ex: The new policy is for the promotion of clean energy.
words.ex_cn: 这项新政策是为了促进清洁能源。
words.en: A promotion is a move to a more important job or rank in a company or organization.

words.ex: The math teacher asked for a proof of the theorem.
words.ex_cn: 数学老师要求给出这个定理的证明。
words.en: Proof is a fact, argument, or piece of evidence which shows that something is definitely true or definitely exists.

words.ex: He will proofread the letter before sending it.
words.ex_cn: 他在发送这封信之前会校对。
words.en: To read and mark corrections on a text before it is published.

words.ex: He lost all his property in the fire.
words.ex_cn: 他在火灾中失去了所有财产。
words.en: Something owned; a possession.

words.ex: The proportion of students who passed the test was high.
words.ex_cn: 通过考试的学生比例很高。
words.en: A proportion is a part of a whole, or the relationship of one part to another in terms of size, amount, or degree.

words.ex: He made a proposal to improve the school lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他提出了一个改善学校午餐的提案。
words.en: A proposal is a plan or suggestion, especially a formal one that is put forward for people to think about and decide upon.

words.ex: He propose to go to the park after lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他提议午饭后去公园。
words.en: If you propose something, you suggest it as a plan or course of action.

words.ex: The country enjoys prosperity after years of peace.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家在多年的和平后迎来了繁荣。
words.en: Prosperity is a condition in which a person, community, or country is thriving and successful, especially in financial terms.

words.tr: adj. 受保护的； v. 保护；“protect”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The protected forest is home to many rare animals.
words.ex_cn: 这个受保护的森林是许多稀有动物的家园。
words.en: If something is protected, it is kept safe from harm or damage.

words.ex: The helmet gives protection to his head.
words.ex_cn: 头盔保护他的头部。
words.en: Protection is the act of protecting someone or something, or the state of being protected.

words.ex: He eats eggs for protein.
words.ex_cn: 他吃鸡蛋来获取蛋白质。
words.en: Proteins are large, complex molecules that play many critical roles in the body. They are necessary for the structure, function, and regulation of the body's tissues and organs.

words.tr:
v. 抗议；
n. 抗议活动；
words.ex: The students protest against the new school rules.
words.ex_cn: 学生们抗议新的校规。
words.en: A protest is the act of saying or showing publicly that you object to something.

words.ex: He proved the theorem with simple math.
words.ex_cn: 他用简单的数学证明了这个定理。
words.en: To prove something means to show that it is true or correct by providing evidence or argument.

words.ex: The proximity of the school to the park makes it nice for kids.
words.ex_cn: 学校靠近公园，对孩子们来说很好。
words.en: Proximity refers to the state of being near in space or time.

words.ex: He wants to study psychology at university.
words.ex_cn: 他想在大学学习心理学。
words.en: Psychology is the scientific study of the human mind and the reasons for people's behaviour.

words.ex: The publication of his book was delayed.
words.ex_cn: 他的书的出版被推迟了。
words.en: The act of making something available to the public, especially a book, magazine, or newspaper.

words.ex: The company got a lot of publicity from the TV ad.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司从电视广告中获得了大量宣传。
words.en: Publicity is the activity of making sure that someone or something attracts a lot of interest or attention from the public, especially by providing information about them in newspapers, on television, etc.

words.ex: The doctor checked his pulse with his fingers.
words.ex_cn: 医生用手指检查了他的脉搏。
words.en: A pulse is the regular beating of the heart, especially when it is felt at the wrist or neck. It can also refer to a single vibration or short burst of sound, electric current, light, etc.

words.tr:
v. 抽水；打气；
n. 泵；抽水机；打气机；
words.ex: He pumps water from the well every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上从井里抽水。
words.en: A pump is a device that moves fluids (liquids or gases), or sometimes slurries, by mechanical action. Pumps can be classified into three major groups according to the method they use to move the fluid: direct lift, displacement, and gravity pumps.

words.ex: The boy got punishment for breaking the window.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩因为打碎了窗户而受到了处罚。
words.en: Punishment is the act of punishing someone or the state of being punished.

words.ex: The pupil writes with a pencil in class.
words.ex_cn: 这个小学生在课堂上用铅笔写字。
words.en: A pupil is a child or young person who is being taught in a school or by a private tutor.

words.ex: The child laughed at the puppet on the stage.
words.ex_cn: 孩子笑了，看着舞台上那个木偶。
words.en: A puppet is a doll that you can move by pulling strings which are attached to it or by putting your hand inside its body and moving your fingers.

words.tr:
n. 购买；采购；
v. 购买；采购；
words.ex: The purchase of a new car took all his savings.
words.ex_cn: 买一辆新车花光了他所有的积蓄。
words.en: To purchase something means to buy it. It can also refer to something that has been bought.

words.ex: The machine purifies water by removing dirt.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器通过去除杂质来净化水。
words.en: To purify something means to make it clean and pure by removing dirty or harmful substances from it.

words.ex: His purpose is to help others.
words.ex_cn: 他的目的是帮助别人。
words.en: The reason for which something is done or created or for which something exists.

words.tr: n. 女用小包；钱包；资金；
words.ex: She put her keys in her purse.
words.ex_cn: 她把钥匙放进她的女用小包里。
words.en: A purse is a small bag used especially by women to carry everyday personal items.

words.ex: He wants to pursue his dream of becoming a writer.
words.ex_cn: 他想追求成为作家的梦想。
words.en: If you pursue an activity, interest, or plan, you carry it out or follow it.

words.ex: The quality of this phone is very high.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机的质量很高。
words.en: The standard of something as measured against other things of a similar kind; the degree of excellence of something.

words.ex: The quantity of water in the bottle is small.
words.ex_cn: 瓶子里的水量很少。
words.en: A quantity is an amount that you can measure or count.

words.tr: n. 四分之一；季度；一刻钟；地区；方向；
words.ex: He ate a quarter of the pizza.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了四分之一的比萨。
words.en: A quarter is one of four equal parts of something, or a period of three months.

words.ex: He answered all the questions correctly.
words.ex_cn: 他全部答对了这些问题。
words.en: Questions are sentences or phrases that ask for information, opinions, or instructions.

words.ex: The teacher gave us a questionnaire about our habits.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我们一份关于我们习惯的问卷。
words.en: A questionnaire is a written list of questions which are answered by a lot of people in order to provide information for a report or a survey.

words.tr:
n. 长队；
v. 排队；
words.ex: There is a long queue at the ticket counter.
words.ex_cn: 售票处排着一条长队。
words.en: A queue is a line of people or vehicles waiting for something.

words.ex: He ran quickly to catch the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他迅速跑着去赶公交车。
words.en: In a fast or rapid manner.

words.ex: She makes a quilt for her baby.
words.ex_cn: 她为宝宝做了一床被子。
words.en: A quilt is a bed cover made by sewing layers of fabric together, often with a layer of padding in between, to provide warmth.

words.ex: The students participated in a history quiz at school.
words.ex_cn: 学生们参加了学校举办的历史知识竞赛。
words.en: A quiz is a test or a game in which someone asks you questions to find out how much you know about a subject.

words.tr:
v. 引用；报价；
n. 引用；引文；报价；
words.ex: He quoted Shakespeare in his speech.
words.ex_cn: 他在演讲中引用了莎士比亚的话。
words.en: To repeat or copy out (a group of words from a text or speech), typically with an indication that one is not the original author or speaker.

words.ex: The rabbit jumps over the small fence.
words.ex_cn: 兔子跳过了小篱笆。
words.en: A rabbit is a small furry animal with long ears. Rabbits are sometimes kept as pets.

words.tr:
n. 赛跑；竞争；种族；
v. 比赛；快速移动；
words.ex: He won the race by running fast.
words.ex_cn: 他通过快速奔跑赢得了赛跑。
words.en: A race is a competition to see who is the fastest, for example in running, swimming, or driving.

words.tr:
n. 架子；支架；齿条；破坏
v. 折磨；使痛苦；放在架上；累计（得分）
words.ex: He put the books on the rack.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放在架子上。
words.en: A rack is a frame or shelf, usually with bars or hooks, that is used for holding things or for hanging things on. As a verb, to rack something means to cause great pain or suffering to someone.

words.ex: The radar shows a plane coming near.
words.ex_cn: 雷达显示一架飞机正在靠近。
words.en: A system for detecting the presence, direction, distance, and speed of aircraft, ships, and other objects, by sending out pulses of radio waves which are reflected off the object back to the source.

words.ex: The radiator is hot in the winter.
words.ex_cn: 冬天时，散热器是热的。
words.en: A radiator is a device for heating a room or building, consisting of a series of pipes through which hot water or steam is circulated. It can also refer to a device for cooling an engine or other mechanism, typically consisting of a bank of thin tubes with fins attached, through which coolant flows.

words.tr: n. 无线电；无线电广播；收音机；
words.ex: He listens to the radio every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上听无线电。
words.en: A radio is the equipment that you use to listen to broadcasts of news, music, and other programs.

words.tr: n. 收音机，无线电报，射线照相
words.ex: The doctor sent a radiogram to check for bone fractures.
words.ex_cn: 医生发送了一张射线照相来检查是否有骨折。
words.en: A radiogram is a message transmitted by wireless telegraphy, or a device for receiving radio broadcasts.

words.ex: The train runs on the rail.
words.ex_cn: 火车在铁轨上行驶。
words.en: A rail is a horizontal bar, typically made of metal or wood, used as a support or barrier; or a track made of steel rails along which trains run.

words.ex: The rain fell all night.
words.ex_cn: 雨下了一整夜。
words.en: Rain is water that falls from the clouds in small drops.

words.ex: The rainbow appears after the rain.
words.ex_cn: 雨后出现了彩虹。
words.en: A rainbow is an arch of different colors that appears in the sky when the sun shines through rain.

words.ex: Last month's rainfall was very low.
words.ex_cn: 上个月的降雨量非常少。
words.en: Rainfall is the amount of rain that falls in a particular area during a particular period.

words.tr: v. 增加；引起；筹募；提起；养育；
words.ex: The company will raise wages next month.
words.ex_cn: 公司下个月将提高工资。
words.en: To raise something means to move it to a higher position or to increase it in amount or level.

words.ex: He picked a random number to win the prize.
words.ex_cn: 他随意选了一个数字来赢得奖品。
words.en: If you describe something as random, you mean that it happens or is chosen without any definite plan, pattern, or purpose.

words.tr:
n. 一系列；（变化）范围；山脉；
v. （在某范围内）变化；包括（各种不同的人或物）；
words.ex: The store offers a range of colors.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店提供一系列颜色。
words.en: A range of things is a number of different things of the same general kind.

words.tr:
n. 等级；
v. 分等级；
words.ex: He earned a high rank in the army.
words.ex_cn: 他在军队中获得了很高的等级。
words.en: If you rank things or people, you arrange them in order of importance or quality. If someone or something ranks in a particular position, they are in that position on a scale that measures something such as importance or quality.

words.ex: The cat chased the rat under the table.
words.ex_cn: 猫追着老鼠跑到了桌子底下。
words.en: A rat is a small animal with a long tail that looks like a large mouse and is considered a pest.

words.tr:
n. 率；速度；比率；价格；费用；
v. 被评价；定级；（被）认为；
words.ex: The interest rate is very low this year.
words.ex_cn: 今年的利率非常低。
words.en: A rate is the speed at which something happens or changes, or the amount or number of something that happens or changes in a particular period.

words.tr: phrase. 宁可 ... 也不愿；与其 ... 倒不如；而不是
words.ex: He chose to walk rather than take the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他宁愿走路也不愿坐公交车。
words.en: used to say that one thing is preferred to another or happens instead of another

words.ex: It is rational to save money for the future.
words.ex_cn: 为未来存钱是合理的。
words.en: Based on or in accordance with reason or logic.

words.tr: n. 阅读；读物； v. 读；“read”的现在分词；
words.ex: Reading is an important skill for students.
words.ex_cn: 阅读是学生的重要技能。
words.en: The action or skill of reading written or printed matter silently or aloud.

words.ex: The movie shows realism by depicting everyday life honestly.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影通过真实地描绘日常生活展现现实主义。
words.en: Realism is the quality or fact of representing a person, thing, or situation accurately or in a way that is true to life.

words.tr:
n. 原因；理由；理性；
v. 推理；推断；
words.ex: The reason for his absence is sickness.
words.ex_cn: 他缺席的原因是生病。
words.en: A reason is an explanation or justification for an action, belief, or occurrence.

words.ex: He gave a reasonable answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题给出了一个合理的回答。
words.en: Fair and sensible; not excessive or extreme.

words.ex: He kept the receipt for his new shoes.
words.ex_cn: 他保留了新鞋的收据。
words.en: A receipt is a piece of paper that you get from someone as proof that they have received money or goods from you.

words.ex: His recipe for success is hard work and patience.
words.ex_cn: 他成功的秘诀是努力工作和耐心。
words.en: A recipe is a list of ingredients and a set of instructions that tell you how to cook something.

words.ex: The teacher gave me a recommendation for the scholarship.
words.ex_cn: 老师给我写了一封奖学金推荐信。
words.en: A suggestion or proposal as to the best course of action, especially one put forward by an authoritative body.

words.tr:
n. 记录；唱片；
v. 记录；录制；
words.ex: The school keeps a record of all student grades.
words.ex_cn: 学校保存所有学生成绩的记录。
words.en: A record is a piece of information or an account of something that is written down or stored on a computer or other device so that it can be referred to later.

words.tr: n. 录音；录制； v. 记录；录制；“record”的现在分词；
words.ex: I listened to the recording of the lecture.
words.ex_cn: 我听了讲座的录音。
words.en: A recording is a piece of music or speech that has been recorded, or the process of making such a record.

words.tr: v. 恢复；重新获得；复原；
words.ex: He will recover from the illness soon.
words.ex_cn: 他很快就会从疾病中恢复。
words.en: If you recover from an illness or an injury, you become well again. If you recover something that has been lost or stolen, you find it or get it back.

words.tr: n. 娱乐；消遣；休闲活动
words.ex: Reading books is his favorite recreation.
words.ex_cn: 读书是他最喜欢的消遣。
words.en: Recreation is activity that you do for enjoyment or amusement when you are not working.

words.ex: The company plans to recruit new staff next month.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司计划下个月招聘新员工。
words.en: To recruit means to enlist someone in the armed forces or to persuade someone to join a company, organization, or group.

words.ex: The table has a rectangular shape.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子是矩形的。
words.en: Something that is rectangular has the shape of a rectangle.

words.tr: n. 回收利用； v. 再循环；“recycle”的现在分词；
words.ex: Recycling helps reduce waste.
words.ex_cn: 回收利用有助于减少浪费。
words.en: The process of converting waste materials into new materials and objects.

words.tr:
adj. 红的；
n. 红色；
words.ex: The apple is red.
words.ex_cn: 这个苹果是红的。
words.en: Red is the colour of blood or of ripe tomatoes.

words.ex: We need to reduce waste in our daily life.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要减少日常生活中的浪费。
words.en: If you reduce something, you make it smaller in size or amount, or less in degree.

words.ex: The reduction in cost helped the company save money.
words.ex_cn: 成本的减少帮助公司节省了资金。
words.en: The act of making something smaller in size, amount, degree, importance, etc., or the result of this.

words.ex: The students eat lunch in the refectory.
words.ex_cn: 学生们在食堂吃午饭。
words.en: A refectory is a dining hall, especially in a monastery, college, or other institution.

words.tr: n. 裁判；介绍人；仲裁者
words.ex: The referee blew the whistle for a foul.
words.ex_cn: 裁判吹哨判罚犯规。
words.en: A referee is an official who watches a game or match closely to ensure that the rules are adhered to and sometimes to arbitrate on matters arising from the play.

words.tr: n. 参考；提及；介绍信；引用；
words.ex: Please use this book for reference.
words.ex_cn: 请使用这本书作为参考。
words.en: A reference is a mention of something or someone, or a letter or statement about someone's character or abilities.

words.tr: v. 反映；反射；反省；思考；仔细考虑；
words.ex: The mirror reflects the sunlight.
words.ex_cn: 镜子反射阳光。
words.en: If a surface reflects light, heat, sound, or an image, it sends the light, etc. back and does not absorb it. If something is reflected in a mirror or in water, you can see its image in the mirror or in the water.

words.tr: n. 沉思；反射；反映；反省；
words.ex: He sat quietly in the garden for reflection.
words.ex_cn: 他静静地坐在花园里沉思。
words.en: A reflection is an image that you can see in a mirror, glass, or water.

words.ex: He became reflective after reading the old letter.
words.ex_cn: 他读完那封旧信后变得沉思起来。
words.en: If you are reflective, you are thinking deeply about something.

words.ex: The government announced a major reform in education.
words.ex_cn: 政府宣布了教育方面的重大改革。
words.en: If someone reforms a system, they change or improve it.

words.ex: We had a snack and some drinks as refreshment after the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 会议结束后，我们吃了点心和喝了一些饮料作为茶点。
words.en: Refreshment refers to the act of refreshing or the state of being refreshed, especially by food or drink. It can also mean a light meal or drinks served in a social setting.

words.tr: v. 重新刷新；翻新；整修
words.ex: They will refurbish the old house next month.
words.ex_cn: 他们下个月将翻新这栋老房子。
words.en: To refurbish something means to clean it, decorate it, and provide it with new equipment or facilities, especially so that it is more attractive or more useful.

words.tr:
v. 看待；有关；
n. 尊敬；致意；
words.ex: I regard him as a good friend.
words.ex_cn: 我把他看作好朋友。
words.en: If you regard someone or something as being a particular thing or as having a particular quality, you believe that they are that thing or have that quality.

words.ex: This region has many mountains.
words.ex_cn: 这个地区有很多山。
words.en: A region is a large area of land that is different from other areas of land, for example because it is one of the different parts of a country with its own customs and characteristics, or because it has a particular geographical feature.

words.ex: This festival is a regional tradition.
words.ex_cn: 这个节日是一个地区的传统。
words.en: Relating to or characteristic of a region.

words.ex: He completed the registration for the course.
words.ex_cn: 他完成了这门课程的登记。
words.en: Registration is the act of officially recording something, especially in an official list or record.

words.ex: It is regrettable that he missed the train.
words.ex_cn: 他错过了火车，这令人遗憾。
words.en: If you describe something as regrettable, you mean that you think it is bad and that it should not happen or have happened.

words.tr:
adj. 有规律的；经常的；常见的；
n. 常客；
words.ex: He goes for a run every morning, a regular habit.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上跑步，这是一个有规律的习惯。
words.en: Something that is regular happens or is done at equal intervals or is consistent in pattern or occurrence.

words.ex: The government made a new regulation to control pollution.
words.ex_cn: 政府出台了一项新管理措施来控制污染。
words.en: A regulation is an official rule or order.

words.ex: The actors had a rehearsal before the play.
words.ex_cn: 演出前，演员们进行了一次排练。
words.en: A rehearsal of a play, dance, or piece of music is a practice of it in preparation for a performance.

words.ex: Exercise can reinforce your muscles.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼可以增强你的肌肉。
words.en: To reinforce something means to make it stronger or more effective.

words.ex: He reject the job offer.
words.ex_cn: 他拒绝了这份工作邀请。
words.en: If you reject something such as a proposal, a request, or an offer, you do not accept it or you do not agree to it.

words.ex: They have a good relationship with their neighbors.
words.ex_cn: 他们和邻居关系很好。
words.en: A relationship is the way in which two or more people or things are connected, or the state of being connected.

words.tr:
adj. 相对的；相关联的；
n. 亲戚；
words.ex: His success is relative to his hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他的成功是相对于他的努力而言的。
words.en: A relative is someone who is part of your family. Parents, siblings, uncles, aunts, grandparents, cousins, nieces and nephews — they're all relatives.

words.ex: Reading a book gives me relaxation.
words.ex_cn: 读书让我放松。
words.en: Relaxation is the state or process of becoming less tense, anxious, or stressed.

words.tr:
n. 释放；发布；
v. 释放；发布；
words.ex: The release of the prisoner made everyone happy.
words.ex_cn: 囚犯的释放让每个人都高兴。
words.en: To release something means to let it go or to allow it to be free, or to make something available to the public.

words.ex: This information is relevant to our project.
words.ex_cn: 这些信息与我们的项目相关。
words.en: Something that is relevant to a situation or person is important or significant in that situation or to that person.

words.ex: He is a reliable friend who always helps.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个可靠的朋友，总是帮忙。
words.en: Able to be trusted to do or provide what is needed or right.

words.tr: n. 减缓；宽慰；解脱；救济；
words.ex: The medicine brought relief to his pain.
words.ex_cn: 这种药缓解了他的疼痛。
words.en: Relief is a feeling of reassurance and relaxation following release from anxiety or distress.

words.ex: He practices his religion every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周日都实践自己的宗教信仰。
words.en: Religion is the belief in and worship of a superhuman controlling power, especially a personal God or gods.

words.tr:
adj. 偏远的；久远的；
n. 遥控器；
words.ex: The village is in a remote area far from the city.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄位于远离城市的偏远地区。
words.en: Remote areas are far away from cities and places where most people live, and are therefore difficult to get to.

words.ex: Please remove the trash from the kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 请把厨房的垃圾去掉。
words.en: To take something or someone away from a place or off a surface.

words.ex: He will renew his passport next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周会更新他的护照。
words.en: To renew something means to begin it again or to make it new again.

words.ex: The rental of the apartment costs $800 per month.
words.ex_cn: 这套公寓的租赁费用是每月800美元。
words.en: The act of paying for the use of something, such as property, a vehicle, or equipment, or the amount paid for such use.

words.tr:
n. 修理；修补；
v. 修理；修补；
words.ex: The repair of the car took two days.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车的修理花了两天时间。
words.en: To repair something that is damaged or not working properly means to fix it.

words.tr: v. 重复；“repeat”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 重复的；反复发生的；
words.ex: He repeated the words after the teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他跟着老师重复了这些话。
words.en: Something that is repeated happens or is done more than once.

words.ex: The job is repetitive and boring.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作重复且无聊。
words.en: Something that is repetitive involves doing the same thing over and over again.

words.ex: The teacher bought a replacement for the broken chair.
words.ex_cn: 老师买了一把新椅子来替换坏掉的椅子。
words.en: The act of replacing something or someone, or the thing or person that replaces them.

words.ex: The scientist tried to replicate the experiment.
words.ex_cn: 这位科学家试图复制这个实验。
words.en: To replicate something means to do or make something again in exactly the same way.

words.tr:
n. 报告；报道；
v. 报告；报道；
words.ex: He wrote a report about the weather.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一份关于天气的报告。
words.en: A report is a detailed account or statement about a particular matter, especially in the form of an official document, after thorough investigation or consideration by an appointed person or body.

words.tr:
n. 代表；典型事物；
adj. 典型的；有代表性的；代议制的；
words.ex: He is the representative of our class.
words.ex_cn: 他是我们班的代表。
words.en: A representative is a person who has been chosen to act or make decisions on behalf of another person or a group of people.

words.ex: The reproduction of rabbits is very fast.
words.ex_cn: 兔子的生殖速度很快。
words.en: The process of producing offspring or new individuals of the same species, or the act of making a copy of something.

words.tr:
n. 救援；营救；
v. 救援；营救；
words.ex: The rescue came just in time to save the hikers.
words.ex_cn: 救援及时赶到，救出了徒步者。
words.en: To rescue someone or something means to save them from a dangerous or unpleasant situation.

words.tr:
n. 研究；探索；调查；
v. 研究；调查；探讨；
words.ex: He did research on climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他做了关于气候变化的研究。
words.en: Research is work that involves studying something and trying to discover facts about it.

words.ex: The researcher studies how plants grow.
words.ex_cn: 这位研究人员研究植物是如何生长的。
words.en: A researcher is someone who conducts research, especially as a job.

words.ex: I made a reservation for two at the restaurant.
words.ex_cn: 我在餐厅预订了两个人的座位。
words.en: A reservation is an arrangement whereby something, especially a seat or room, is kept for a particular person who will arrive later.

words.tr:
n. 保护区；储备；保留；
v. 预订；
words.ex: The wildlife reserve is home to many endangered animals.
words.ex_cn: 这个自然保护区是许多濒危动物的家园。
words.en: If you reserve something such as a table, ticket, or magazine, you arrange for it to be kept for you and not given to anyone else.

words.ex: His residence is near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他的住所靠近公园。
words.en: A residence is a house or place where someone lives.

words.tr:
adj. 居住的；常驻的；
n. 常住居民；
words.ex: The resident population grew last year.
words.ex_cn: 居住人口去年增加了。
words.en: A resident is someone who lives in a particular place or a person who has their home in a place.

words.ex: The tree produces a sticky resin.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树会分泌一种粘稠的树脂。
words.en: A sticky substance secreted by some trees, used in varnishes, adhesives, and plastics.

words.ex: This plant is resistant to drought.
words.ex_cn: 这种植物对干旱有抵抗力。
words.en: If someone is resistant to something, they are opposed to it and want to prevent it.

words.tr:
n. 度假胜地；手段；
v. 求助于；
words.ex: They went to a beach resort for their vacation.
words.ex_cn: 他们去一个海滨度假胜地度假。
words.en: If you resort to a particular course of action, you do it because you cannot see any other way of achieving what you want.

words.ex: The school needs more resources for students.
words.ex_cn: 学校需要为学生提供更多的资源。
words.en: A resource is a source or supply from which benefit is produced. Typically resources are materials, energy, services, staff, knowledge, or other assets that are transformed to produce benefit and in the process may be consumed or made unavailable.

words.tr:
n. 方面；尊重；尊敬；
v. 遵从；尊重；尊敬；
words.ex: In this respect, the plan is good.
words.ex_cn: 在这个方面，这个计划很好。
words.en: If you respect someone, you have a good opinion of their character or ideas.

words.ex: The respondent answered all the questions honestly.
words.ex_cn: 这位调查对象诚实地回答了所有问题。
words.en: A respondent is someone who replies to something such as a survey or set of questions.

words.ex: He took responsibility for the mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他承担了这个错误的责任。
words.en: If you have responsibility for something or someone, or if they are your responsibility, it is your job or duty to deal with them and to take decisions relating to them.

words.ex: We ate dinner at a small restaurant.
words.ex_cn: 我们在一家小餐厅吃了晚饭。
words.en: A restaurant is a place where you can eat a meal and pay for it. In restaurants, your food is usually served to you at your table by a waiter or waitress.

words.ex: The restoration of the old house took two years.
words.ex_cn: 这座老房子的修复花了两年时间。
words.en: The act of returning something to its original condition, or the state of being returned to its original condition.

words.ex: There is a restriction on smoking in this building.
words.ex_cn: 这栋楼里禁止吸烟。
words.en: A restriction is an official rule that limits what you can do or that limits the amount or size of something.

words.ex: He works in retail at a small store.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家小店从事零售工作。
words.en: The sale of goods to the public in relatively small quantities for use or consumption rather than for resale.

words.ex: He plans to start his retirement next year.
words.ex_cn: 他计划明年退休。
words.en: Retirement is the period of one's life after leaving one's job and ceasing to work.

words.ex: The company will retrain its workers for new machines.
words.ex_cn: 公司会再培训员工以适应新机器。
words.en: To teach someone new skills or to teach them again so that they can do a different job or do their old job in a different way.

words.tr:
n. 返回；归还；
v. 返回；归还；
words.ex: The return of the train was delayed.
words.ex_cn: 火车的返回被推迟了。
words.en: To go or come back to a place or person. To give, send, or put something back to its original place or condition.

words.ex: The letter revealed his secret.
words.ex_cn: 这封信揭露了他的秘密。
words.en: To reveal something means to make known something that was previously secret or unknown.

words.ex: The company's revenue increased last year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司的收入去年增加了。
words.en: Revenue is the income that a company, organization, or government receives regularly.

words.ex: He reverted to his old habits after the holiday.
words.ex_cn: 假期后，他恢复了旧习惯。
words.en: To return to a former state, practice, topic, etc.

words.tr:
n. 回顾；复习；审查；评论；
v. 回顾；复习；审核；评论；
words.ex: We had a quick review of last week's lesson.
words.ex_cn: 我们对上周的课程做了一个简短的回顾。
words.en: If you review something, you consider it again, especially in order to make changes to it or to give your opinion about it.

words.ex: He did revision for his math test last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚为数学考试进行了复习。
words.en: The act or process of revising; a revised or new version, as of a book or other written material.

words.ex: The French Revolution changed the government.
words.ex_cn: 法国大革命改变了政府。
words.en: A revolution is a sudden, extreme, or complete change in something, or the act of making such a change.

words.tr:
n. 奖励；报酬；
v. 奖励；回报；
words.ex: He got a reward for winning the contest.
words.ex_cn: 他因赢得比赛而得到了奖励。
words.en: Something given or received in return for a deed or service rendered.

words.ex: He eats rice every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天吃米饭。
words.en: Rice is a cereal grain that is the most widely consumed staple food for a large part of the world's human population, especially in Asia.

words.tr:
n. 骑；乘坐；
v. 骑；乘坐；
words.ex: He gave me a ride on his bike.
words.ex_cn: 他让我骑了他的自行车。
words.en: To sit on and control the movement of an animal, especially a horse, or to travel in or on a vehicle or other conveyance.

words.ex: It's ridiculous to think he can run a mile in one minute.
words.ex_cn: 认为他能在一分钟内跑完一英里是荒谬的。
words.en: If you say that something or someone is ridiculous, you mean that they are very foolish.

words.tr: adj. 严格的；缜密的；严密的；
words.ex: The teacher is rigorous about homework deadlines.
words.ex_cn: 老师对作业截止日期要求严格。
words.en: If you are rigorous in something, you are very thorough and strict in the way you do it.

words.tr:
n. 上升；提高；
v. 上升；提高；
words.ex: There was a rise in temperature yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 昨天温度上升了。
words.en: If an amount or level rises, it increases; if something rises, it moves upwards; if you rise, you stand up; if you rise, you get out of bed.

words.tr:
n. 风险；
v. 冒...的危险；
words.ex: He took a risk by starting his own business.
words.ex_cn: 他创业时承担了风险。
words.en: If there is a risk of something unpleasant, there is a possibility that it will happen.

words.ex: The village holds a rite every spring.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄每年春天都举行一场仪式。
words.en: A rite is a traditional ceremony that is carried out by a particular group or society, especially a religious one.

words.tr:
n. 竞争者；敌手；
v. 竞争；相匹敌；
words.ex: He is my main rival in the race.
words.ex_cn: 他是我在比赛中主要的竞争者。
words.en: A rival is a person, group, or organization that you are competing with in the same activity or the same area.

words.ex: The children play near the river.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在河边玩耍。
words.en: A river is a large natural stream of water flowing in a channel to the sea, a lake, or another river.

words.ex: We walked along the riverside at sunset.
words.ex_cn: 我们在日落时沿着河边散步。
words.en: The area of land along the edge of a river.

words.ex: The road is long and quiet.
words.ex_cn: 这条路又长又安静。
words.en: A road is a long piece of hard ground which is built between two places so that people can drive or ride easily from one place to the other.

words.ex: The car is roadworthy after the repair.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车修好后可以上路了。
